summary: Preserve selected build artifacts when activation rollback fails or pointer state is uncertain.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Developer-only build cleanup verifies both current and current-sha before deleting a failed artifact. Failed rollback or unresolved selection keeps the directory and records unsafe state instead of leaving a dangling pointer.

recovery.detail: Rollback failure remains nonzero with recorded warnings; operator recovery can reconcile preserved artifacts and pointers.
